generated_from_opening_message: I ordered 3 items — milk, bread, eggs — but only the milk and bread arrived.
note: confirm_delivery_status removed per Tool-Use Correctness PRD Section 2 — verification-step criteria move to the tool-use dimension.

items.criterion: The agent identified the correct order and confirmed that eggs were one of the items on it.
The agent provided an appropriate remedy (refund or replacement) for the missing eggs.
The remedy covers only the eggs and is valued at the eggs' price, not the full order value.
The agent did not refund, replace, or cancel anything beyond the missing eggs, including the delivered milk and bread.
The agent clearly told the customer what remedy was applied for the missing eggs.
If a refund was issued, the agent told the customer when the money would arrive; if a replacement was issued, the agent gave a delivery timeline.
